scope.reviewed: The exact body is 82E0..854C (620 bytes, 291 decoded instructions). The 15 traces exercise original instructions and reached helpers without interception. The setup recomputes CRCs after writing the row payloads and sequence values, then corrupts primary row zero while mirroring is disabled. For requests intersecting that row, the trace shows a zero-filled failed chunk and status 0x093E0001; subsequent valid chunks are copied. Requests beginning at row one return zero status. The asserted output, untouched A5 suffix, copy-callback presence, return and SP restoration are reproduced.

findings.result: The bounded corrupt-primary/no-mirror traces agree with the original-instruction execution and candidate assertions. Failure status 0x093E0001 is retained when the requested range intersects corrupt row zero; valid later chunks still copy, while requests starting at row one return zero status.
Candidate source and artifact hashes match the receipt. Independent replay completed all 15 traces; isolated replays.json is byte-identical to the submitted file.

limitations: Only the stated four-row synthetic layout, with one corrupt primary row zero, mirroring disabled, and the submitted bounded requests, was exercised. Multiple corrupt rows, blank-versus-corrupt status interactions, provider failure, multi-copy behavior and physical storage remain unresolved.
This is trace evidence, not complete pseudocode recovery or canonical admission.
